summary: Frontend-only E2E verification of message-304 feature block (Team-Leader filter, Meal range dates + validation, Structure auto-fill, range display, Per-giorno expansion, Per-struttura aggregation, legacy backward compatibility). Logged in as org-admin tabtest_1790713653@crmevent.it. All 8 requested flows verified via Playwright. RESULTS: (1) Anagrafiche → Team → Nuovo team: Team Leader dropdown shows ONLY 3 Staff/Volontari (Enrico Trambe, Stef Volo, TestM Ember) vs 9 total anagrafiche — alphabetical, event-scoped, no company-only referenti. Both Trail del Lago and Fiera Test return the same 3 (this org has these 3 staff linked to both events). Changing Evento re-triggers the leaderOptions callback. Placeholder 'Solo Staff & Volontari dell'evento' visible. (2) Ospitalità → Sara Neri → Pasti → Aggiungi pasto: form shows Data inizio + Data fine + Tipo pasto + Tipologia servizio + Struttura/Fornitore (da anagrafica) + Luogo + Indirizzo + Referente + Telefono + Orario + A carico + Costo + Note. data-testid=meal-data-inizio and meal-data-fine present as spec'd. (3) Invalid range (inizio=2026-10-20, fine=2026-10-16) → Save shows the EXACT toast wording: 'La data di fine non può precedere la data di inizio' (Sonner red toast). (4) Valid range (16→20 Oct) with Tipo=Colazione and no struct → Save shows 'Pasto salvato' toast and the meal appears in the Pasti list as 'Colazione · 16–20 ottobre 2026' (formatDateRange output correct). (5) Structure auto-fill: selecting 'Hotel Bellavista · Hotel' from the Struttura anagrafica picker (data-testid=meal-select → meal-opt-<id>) auto-filled Luogo=Hotel Bellavista, Indirizzo=Via Roma 12, Referente=Reception, Telefono=+39031123456. struct-missing-note not shown because all fields were present (correct behavior). (6) Per giorno view: for the Sara colazione 16→20 October range, Sara Neri appears in the Colazione column for EACH of days 2026-10-16, 10-17, 10-18, 10-19, 10-20 (verified all 5 days). Day selector only lists days that have meals/lodgings (16-20 all listed). (7) Per struttura/servizio: Hotel Bellavista card is aggregated ONCE (no per-day duplication) with counts (2 pernott., 1 Pranzo). (8) Legacy single-date meals (Cena · 12 luglio 2026 for Sara, Pranzo · 12 luglio 2026 · 13:30 for Marco) display correctly as a single day, no duplication, no data loss.

issues: Data-fine input has a browser-enforced min=data-inizio which is helpful, but combined with the frontend validator it means invalid range can only be reached via keyboard editing after typing (my test had to removeAttribute('min') to reach the invalid state). Real users typing dates manually can still trigger the correct client-side toast. Not a bug — dual-layer prevention is a plus.

critical_code_review_comments: Hospitality.jsx MealForm data-testids follow a MEAL-prefix convention (meal-tipo, meal-select, save-meal) which differs from the review-request wording 'field-tipo_pasto'. This is fine and consistent, but update the message-304 spec doc so future testers use meal-tipo/meal-select/save-meal.
The `field-responsabile_id` combobox correctly binds to leaderOptions(form) via field.dynamicOptions in crm.jsx L282 — no cross-event leakage observed. Good separation of concerns.

The struct-missing-note conditional is not triggerable from the seeded data (all Trail del Lago structures have Luogo/Indirizzo/Referente/Telefono/Google Maps set). Add a QA seed with a partially-filled structure to exercise this branch in future regression.

(b) Marco Verdi → range 2026-11-05 → 2026-11-07 with Hotel Bellavista autofill — used to verify Structure auto-fill (Luogo/Indirizzo/Referente/Telefono). Leaving these in place will not affect production isolation; delete via Ospitalità → person → Pasti tab if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Message-304 feature block fully verified frontend-side. Key testids: meal-data-inizio, meal-data-fine, meal-tipo, meal-servizio, meal-select, meal-opt-<structureId>, meal-carico, save-meal, struct-missing-note, field-evento_id, field-responsabile_id, field-nome, hosp-event-select. The Team Leader dropdown correctly uses staffLinks → staffVolByEvent map with alphabetical sort. Legacy meals with only `data` are normalized server-side via _normalize_meals() to data_inizio=data_fine, keeping the UI compat. Briefing page range rendering was NOT re-verified in this iteration because backend curl by main agent already confirmed briefing-live returns the range meal and Briefing.jsx uses the shared formatDateRange() helper — same output as Pasti list which was verified visually as '16–20 ottobre 2026'.
